newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Bids mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Bids mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: Cash bids for millfeeds were narrowly mixed Monday and trade was thin as competing feed ingredients continued to flood the market, several cash dealers said.
Hard red winter wheat harvest was progressing in Kansas, the leading U.S. winter wheat producer, and yields were coming in above expectation.

Meanwhile, growing conditions in the U.S. Midwest were said to be ideal for corn with hot, humid weather over the weekend and more in store. In the northeast, barley and hay crops were attracting feed mixers.
"We're seeing some new crop barley beginning to move out of Pennsylvania," a northern New York dealer said. "That kind of puts a cap on our (millfeed) market. The hay crop has also come in well."
